title: lambda-rfi-mitigation: eigen-subspace RFI mitigation with directional protection for the LAMBDA array
description:
Offline RFI-mitigation and imaging code for the LAMBDA 36-element radio interferometer, together with paper/paper-figures.ipynb, the notebook that regenerates every figure in Smallwood et al., Protecting astronomical sources during adaptive spatial filtering for radio frequency interference mitigation with the LAMBDA dipole array.

Short-term visibility covariances are peeled of a scaled Haslam sky prior, whitened, projected free of a fixed-rank interference subspace while protecting chosen directions (the Sun), restored, and imaged by direct DFT. A clean, RFI-free channel observed at the same time provides the reference against which mitigation is scored.

The two ~10 GiB raw visibility captures the notebook consumes are archived as a separate data record; see the README for how to point $LAMBDA_DATA_PATH at them.
